segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report a non-greasy, dewy-not-shiny finish that sits well under makeup, though a couple say it feels oily or leaves them shinier than expected.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and moisturizing with no white cast, and one notes it gave a nice glow rather than looking cakey.
segments.combination: The one combination-leaning report (occasionally dry, occasionally red) found it light with a manageable glow, only faulting the excessive shine.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most split: many report no stinging, breakouts or redness and call it their holy grail, while a distinct cluster describes burning, itching, blistering, red inflamed skin or whiteheads, sometimes within hours of use.
segments.normal: The one normal-skin reviewer (with occasional dryness/redness) found it light and non-irritating on the face but very shiny.
segments.mature: A 44-year-old and a 53-year-old reviewer both report no pilling, no wrinkle/line enhancement, and a dewy, comfortable wear, calling it well suited to mature skin.

concerns.aging: Two mature-skin reviewers report it does not settle into lines or emphasize wrinkles and one cites added anti-aging ingredients as a plus; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers with dry skin report it hydrates well and leaves a healthy glow without heaviness; no negative reports specific to dry skin's hydration.
concerns.redness: Sensitive and reactive-skin reviewers are divided: several report no redness or irritation, but others describe their face turning tomato red, inflamed, or breaking out in red painful clusters after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the formula with helping restore the skin barrier; no dissenting barrier-specific complaints are reported.
concerns.spots: Reviewers prone to sunburn report mixed results: many say they avoided burning even during beach days or gardening, but several others report getting sunburnt or peeling despite reapplication.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers largely report no new breakouts and call it a holy-grail non-comedogenic option, but a minority describe sudden clusters of whiteheads, tiny pimples, or cystic-feeling breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly say it controls shine and doesn't feel greasy, though a couple mention it still felt oily or produced a heavy shine on their skin.
